packages.name: MetaTrader 5
packages.description: MetaTrader 5 terminal runtime with the Nile bridge.

versions.notes: NileTrade 1.7.0: tick values on each quote (nile #805); a bracket protection whose position closed before binding ends instead of staying active (nile #796); Go 1.27.4; Wine 11.20. Supersedes main-e66c718.

NileTrade 1.6.0: pip size per instrument for stops in pips, stops inside the spread refused before sending (stops_invalid), route rules applied to route orders (nile #780, #779); Go 1.27.4; Wine 11.20. Supersedes main-253a447.

NileTrade 1.5.0: closed positions report why they closed (stop out, close in an MT5 terminal, besides order, SL, TP and outside the platform) (nile #669); includes the stops-in-units fix of main-102c6ef (#666); Go 1.27.4; Wine 11.20. Supersedes main-102c6ef.

Stops in units (money, % balance, pips, points) reach nile-risk on the trade socket again: Edit SL/TP keeps converted stops and new orders get them (nile #666); Go 1.27.4; Wine 11.20. Supersedes main-bb07f81.
Real accounts allowed (ADR-055: the demo-only check in NileTrade is withdrawn; stages are checked by the Control Plane), nile 1.2.1-alpha.1; Wine 11.20. Supersedes main-213a8d4.

DirectConnect File channel, same changes as nile-mt5-runtime main-e66c718 (NileTrade 1.6.0, nile #780, #779); Go 1.27.4; Wine 11.20. Supersedes main-253a447.
DirectConnect File channel, same changes as nile-mt5-runtime main-253a447 (NileTrade 1.5.0 close reasons, nile #669); Go 1.27.4; Wine 11.20. Supersedes main-102c6ef.
DirectConnect File channel, same changes as nile-mt5-runtime main-102c6ef (nile #666); Go 1.27.4; Wine 11.20. Supersedes main-bb07f81.
DirectConnect File channel, same changes as nile-mt5-runtime main-bb07f81 (nile 1.2.1-alpha.1); Wine 11.20. Supersedes main-213a8d4.

packages.name: Python strategy runtime
packages.description: Python 3.12 runtime for Nile strategies, run as a separate container next to a trading terminal.

versions.notes: Python 3.12 strategy runtime, built from nile main 0604df7d: apt 3.0.4 (CVE-2026-109518) and zlib 1.3.1-1+deb13u1 (CVE-2026-85091) from the Debian security builds (nile #963). Supersedes 3.12-main-010d18af.
First Python strategy runtime (Python 3.12), built from nile main 010d18af (nile 1.2.0-alpha.1).

packages.name: Interactive Brokers (beta)
packages.description: Interactive Brokers runtime: one container per account with nile-risk, the Nile bridge and the GPL TWS API shim. IB Gateway is downloaded on your server at first start and checked against pinned hashes.

versions.notes: Beta, unverified: not yet run against a real IB account. Stocks, plus forex, spot metals and index CFDs on paper (nile #997). Reads the verified official calendar (nile #1000). OpenJDK 17.0.21.1. Gateway 10.50.1h, TWS API 1050.02, shim v0.2.0. Replaces main-05944dd2.
